title: Move Customers lists the term's customers A to Z, all ticked
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 15 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly three customers, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C} (a new term holds only this case's customers), whose names are in that A to Z order, with credit limits of $500.00, $0.00 and $1,000.00.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-01 N15, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-01 Alpha, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-01 Bravo and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-01 Charlie.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens. It shows, top to bottom: a "Search customers" box; "Select All" and "Select None" with "3 selected" on the right; a list of {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C} in that order, each with a ticked checkbox; a "Move To" dropdown reading Net 30, with the hint "Prefilled with your default for new customers." below it; and the buttons "Cancel" and "Move 3 Customers".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R1: “"Move Customers" in a term's row menu (Story 2: Row menu actions) opens a window titled "Move Customers from {term}".”
  • S4-R2: “The window shows, top to bottom: a "Search customers" box; "Select All" and "Select None" with "{n} selected" on the right; a scrolling list of every customer on the term, A to Z, each with a checkbox; a "Move To" dropdown; and the buttons "Cancel" and "Move {n} Customers" ("Move 1 Customer" when one is selected).”
  • S4-R4: “Every listed customer starts ticked.”
  • S4-R7: “"Move To" offers every active term except the one being moved from, in the S1-R5 order. It is prefilled with the shop's default; while the default is selected, the hint "Prefilled with your default for new customers." shows below it. When the term being moved from is the default, "Move To" starts empty.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move To hint | "Prefilled with your default for new customers." | Hint under Move To while the default is selected”
  • S2-R1 table, Move Customers row: “"Move Customers" (person) | Every term, active or inactive | The user lacks 'Customers → Create & Edit' or 'View and Manage AP/AR Data': "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." Otherwise no customer holds the term: "No customers are on this term"”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "2 Move customers to another term" ("Choose Move Customers", "Move Customers from COD"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

  • “Every customer on COD is listed and ticked. The Counter Sale customer is never listed and never moves.”
  • “The button names the count: "Move 214 Customers". Cancel closes without changes.”
